In May, lawyers for the British broadcaster tried to serve subpoenas to the couple at their home in Miami, according to court filings, but they were blocked by police. The 80-year-old president filed a $10 billion lawsuit against the BBC over a documentary the network aired about the Jan. 6 riot, in which an edited version of the speech he gave during the rally before the riot was screened.
